mapper.sql: id, conversation_id, client_request_id, user_message_id, assistant_message_id, model_id, status, fence_epoch, retry_of_generation_id, error_code, input_token_count, output_token_count, created_at, updated_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_generations (id, conversation_id, client_request_id, user_message_id, assistant_message_id, model_id, status, fence_epoch, retry_of_generation_id, error_code, input_token_count, output_token_count, created_at, updated_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{clientRequestId}, #{userMessageId}, #{assistantMessageId}, #{modelId}, #{status}, #{fenceEpoch}, #{retryOfGenerationId}, #{errorCode}, #{inputTokenCount}, #{outputTokenCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_generations WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_generations SET status = #{newStatus}, error_code = #{errorCode}, input_token_count = #{inputTokenCount}, output_token_count = #{outputTokenCount}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'RETRYABLE') THEN #{updatedAt} ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id} AND fence_epoch = #{epoch} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
